'''Saki Prime''' was a [[Red giant/Legends|red giant]] located in the ''[[Bootana Hutta/Legends|Bootana Hutta]]'' region of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. It was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sakiya]].

==Description==
Saki Prime was a dying [[Star/Legends|star]] which emitted intense [[Radiation/Legends|radiations]]. Despite these intense radiations, the lush [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Sakiya]] thrived beneath a dense protective [[Atmosphere/Legends|ionosphere]].<ref name="LoNH" />

Saki Prime's [[Spectrum/Legends|spectrum]] shifted more toward the [[Color/Legends|red]]. From the surface of Sakiya, the [[Red giant/Legends|red giant]] looked like a swollen crimson jewel hanging in the azure sky.<ref name="BS" />
